style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas  Lambeth Wreath by Dibor
style.toneOfVoice: Decorated with petal shaped woodchips and hand shaped wooden roses, our Lambeth Wreath is not just for Christmas, and will last throughout the Winter to bring some life and colour to your front door. Complete the look with a name or house number of your choice, added to a personalised wooden tag, and lovingly hand tied by our customisation team. Whilst our Christmas wreaths are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, we recommend bringing your wreath indoors during particularly harsh rain or strong winds. Diameter 35cm / 14".
